Metrics: SWE-bench Lite resolution (official harness) and constraint compliance (ContextCov's executable oracle, post-hoc for baselines). The author states no success threshold, so no verdict is given. All with OpenCode + GPT-5.2 (critic for LLM Reflection: Claude Opus 4.5). Number of runs per task not stated
- Vanilla (AGENTS.md in context, no feedback) + OpenCode + GPT-5.2 (baseline): resolved 159/300 (53.0%); compliance 201 (67.0%), avg violations 0.62; end-to-end mean 327.9 s (median 184.7). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- LLM Reflection + OpenCode + GPT-5.2 (critic Claude Opus 4.5): resolved 157 (52.3%); compliance 151 (50.3%), avg violations 1.01; avg rounds 2.85 (column 'Rndsc' 2.30, not defined), 85 hit the 5-round cap (28%); feedback 19,455 chars and 133.7 s mean; end-to-end mean 461.4 s (median 379.2). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- ContextCov + OpenCode + GPT-5.2: resolved 172 (57.3%); compliance 265 (88.3%), avg violations 0.14; avg rounds 1.67 (column 'Rndsc' 1.31, not defined), 29 hit cap (10%); feedback 6,292 chars and 27.7 s mean; end-to-end mean 422.4 s (median 240.0). Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.why: Table 2 has two round columns: 'Rounds' (1.67 ContextCov, 2.85 LLM Reflection, which match the Figure 3 per-round counts over 300 tasks) and an undefined 'Rndsc' (1.31, 2.30); the record gives only the 'Rndsc' values as the average rounds.
fields.doubt: Na Tabela 2 (pág. 8) há duas colunas de rondas: 'Rounds' (1.67 e 2.85) e 'Rndsc' (1.31 e 2.30, sem definição). A média de rondas da Figura 3 (pág. 7) dá 1.67 e 2.85. O registo usa 1.31/2.30 como média. Confirma a ordem das colunas e decide qual valor usar.
